newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares close mixed in live trade.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares close mixed in live trade.

text.p: Four stocks fell, three rose and seven were flat in Warsaw bourse continuous trade on Wednesday.
Turnover eased to 3.8 million zlotys from Tuesday's 6.9 million zlotys.
NFI units rose 1.8 percent to 143.5 zlotys on a turnover of 19.5 million zlotys.
The continuous trading system, which currently lists 15 companies, is separate from the bourse's main single-price auction system in which the same firms and 65 others are traded.
At the single-price auction session most stocks rose and the main market's index jumped 3.1 percent.
